Plan for Rx & Performance.Performance:
  Radio: CS7000-PLUS 2709D157450086 as Connect Systems CS7000-PLUS (radios/cs7000p.yaml), firmware aprs-usb-tnc-fc93d759, DSP image none
  Bench: k0ret, receiver rtlsdr, transmitter hackrf, calibration assumed of 2026-10-20
  70cm: 445.925 MHz (to receiver 58.0 dB, from transmitter 58.3 dB)
  Modes: aprs
  Receive tests (first): attenuator chain from the hackrf to the radio
  Tests (9):
    - 70cm: APRS Perf Every Frame Heard At The Bench Level
    - 70cm: APRS Perf Full-Size Frames Survive The TNC
    - 70cm: APRS Perf Sensitivity
    - 70cm: APRS Perf Twist
    - 70cm: APRS Perf Deviation
    - 70cm: APRS Perf Short TXDELAY
    - 70cm: APRS Perf Off Frequency And Clock Error
    - 70cm: APRS Perf Back To Back
    - 70cm: APRS Perf Soak
Check the setup, then continue to begin.
